visible_delivery_patterns: baseline, lower, and upper scenario branches

license_evidence.product_gate: Confirm Atlas distribution and use are noncommercial or obtain permission before publishing derived HYDE data.

first_artifact_strategy.reason: Validate semantics and conservation before acquiring multi-gigabyte variable bundles or alternate scenarios.

required_source_metadata: exact artifact filename, byte count, and SHA-256
calendar convention for BCE and CE labels
grid CRS, cell registration, resolution, and coordinate order
population-count and population-density variable definitions and units
scenario name and whether bounds are scenarios rather than confidence intervals
normalization_invariants: Never infer cell population by treating density as count.
Never turn nodata, masked water, absent, or not-applicable cells into zero.
Preserve the source grid and scenario identifiers on every normalized observation.
Record source-cell IDs and transformation version for every resampled cell.
Conserve total population within a declared numerical tolerance when resampling.
Do not allocate gridded population to historical polities until overlap and allocation rules are reviewed.
